tasks_recurrence_date_uq.name: tasks_recurrence_date_uq
tasks_recurrence_date_uq.where: "tasks"."recurrence_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_external_uq.name: tasks_external_uq
tasks_external_uq.where: "tasks"."external_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

asset_comments_body_ck.name: asset_comments_body_ck
asset_comments_body_ck.value: length("asset_comments"."body") <= 5000 and ("asset_comments"."action" is not null or length("asset_comments"."body") >= 1)

task_recurrences_when_ck.name: task_recurrences_when_ck
task_recurrences_when_ck.value: ("task_recurrences"."frequency" = 'weekly' and "task_recurrences"."weekday" between 1 and 6) or ("task_recurrences"."frequency" = 'monthly' and ("task_recurrences"."day_of_month" between 1 and 28 or "task_recurrences"."day_of_month" = 31))
